decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher stays close to the core postpress portfolio and fits existing service and consumables routines, and growing industry turnover means there is no shortfall against aspirations that would prompt search for other uses of its resources.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core and its results remain uncertain, but as a flagship with a German premiere it is still early in building a track record, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry it another year.
The sheet preparation module builds on the modular systems and supports sales of complete lines at low carrying cost, so it does not fall short of aspirations enough to justify dropping it.
The B2 multifinisher is a home-page flagship close to the core that embodies the firm's push toward automated finishing workflows, so it very likely meets aspirations and stays.
